headline: This Weekend
in Three Village
dek: Dee Snider inducts Suzette Guilot-Snider into the Music Hall of Fame on Saturday, The Jazz Loft has a Roast & Toast on Friday and Hilary Gardner on Saturday, the Reboli Center throws its Celebrate the Season artist reception and A Christmas Carol plays all weekend at Theatre Three. Here's everything worth doing in Three Village this weekend, updated live.

hero.credit: A Christmas Carol at Theatre Three. Poster: Theatre Three
hero.alt: A Christmas Carol poster for Theatre Three in Port Jefferson

limehof.name: LI Music & Entertainment Hall of Fame

reboli.name: The Reboli Center for Art and History

events.title: Danny Bacher Memorial Roast & Toast at The Jazz Loft
events.price: Tickets online or at the door
events.desc: A memorial Roast & Toast for Danny Bacher, featuring Tom Manuel & the Jazz Loft All Stars, comedian Amadeo Fusco and special guests. Friday at 7 PM.

events.title: Rorie Kelly and Zoe Speed at Grounds & Sounds
events.price: Tickets online or at the door
events.desc: Acoustic night at the Grounds & Sounds Cafe: open mic at 7:30 PM, then Rorie Kelly and Zoe Speed at 8:15 PM. Bring your own bottle of wine.

events.title: Live Music: John Maurice Restrepo and Eduardo Withrington at Madiran
events.desc: Friday night live music at the East Setauket wine bar, 7 to 10 PM. Call 631-675-2778 to reserve a table.

events.title: A Christmas Carol at Theatre Three
events.desc: Theatre Three's annual A Christmas Carol, Long Island's own holiday tradition: Friday and Saturday at 7 PM and Sunday at 3 PM, running through Dec. 27.

events.title: Enduring Heart Lecture & Gallery Walk
events.desc: Archaeologist Allison McGovern of Brookhaven National Laboratory on archaeology and Native American history, followed by a gallery walk. Register at longislandmuseum.org.

events.title: Celebrate the Season Artist's Reception at the Reboli Center
events.credit: Flyer: The Reboli Center for Art and History
events.desc: Meet the 50+ artists and artisans of Celebrate the Season, the Reboli Center's winter exhibition, with sweet and savory refreshments. Saturday 2 to 5 PM, free, no reservations needed.

events.title: Hilary Gardner with the Lonesome Pines at The Jazz Loft
events.desc: Lippe Concert Series: singer Hilary Gardner with the Lonesome Pines (guitar, accordion, bass and drums). Saturday at 7 PM.

events.title: (mostly) TRUE THINGS: Stories About On the Menu
events.price: Tickets online or at the door
events.desc: A game wrapped in a storytelling show, hosted by Jude Treder-Wolff: all but one storyteller slips little lies into their true story, and the audience gets to question them in Act 2. This month's theme is On the Menu.

events.title: Live Music: Douglas Baldwin Jazz Trio at Madiran
events.desc: Saturday night jazz at the East Setauket wine bar, 7 to 10 PM. Call 631-675-2778 to reserve a table.

events.title: Dee Snider Inducts Suzette Guilot-Snider into the Music Hall of Fame
events.credit: Poster: LI Music & Entertainment Hall of Fame
events.desc: Twisted Sister's Dee Snider inducts acclaimed costume designer Suzette Guilot-Snider into the Long Island Music & Entertainment Hall of Fame. Saturday at 8:30 PM.

events.title: Port Jefferson Farmers Market
events.desc: The Sunday market at Harborfront Park, 9 AM to 2 PM. Next Sunday (Nov. 22) is the last one of the season.
